---
title: "HSMA Books"
subtitle: "Freely available to all"
body-classes: neon-title
toc: false
title-block-banner: resources/banner.png
include-back-link: false
page-layout: full
listing:
    - id: books
      contents: "hsma_content/books/book_details/*.qmd"
      sort: "date"
      type: grid
      grid-columns: 2
      categories: false
      template: html/books/listing.ejs
---

```{=html}
<style>
/* Shared neon colours, fonts and .neon-tile live in styles.css (neon design language section) */

/* Two books per row, three on very wide screens, one on phones */
.book-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 1.5rem;
    margin: 1.5rem 0 1rem 0;
}

/* The page body is capped at ~1140px, so on very wide screens let the grid break out of it, centred */
@media (min-width: 1921px) {
    .book-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
        width: min(1800px, calc(100vw - 6rem));
        position: relative;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
    .book-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

.book-card {
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    container-type: inline-size;
}

/* Cover beside the text when the card is wide enough, above it when not */
.book-card-inner {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(160px, 38%) 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
    align-items: start;
}

@container (max-width: 520px) {
    .book-card-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .book-cover {
        max-width: 320px;
    }
}

.book-cover {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid #2e2e2e;
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.book-cover img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
}

.book-cover:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    border-color: var(--accent-soft);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--accent-glow);
}

.book-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    height: 100%;
}

.book-badge {
    padding: 0.05rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: var(--terminal-font);
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--accent-soft);
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 15%, transparent);
}

.book-badge::before {
    content: "> ";
}

/* Override the shared listing title's forced capitalisation, which turns "of" into "Of" */
.book-card .book-title {
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0.75rem 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-family: var(--display-font);
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.05;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: none;
}

.book-abstract {
    flex-grow: 1;
    margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.book-button {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.55rem 1.3rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 2px solid var(--accent-soft);
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 10%, transparent);
    color: var(--accent-soft);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.book-button:hover {
    color: white;
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 22%, transparent);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* Pointer to the modules page, matching the outlined neon buttons elsewhere */
.modules-jump {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 2px solid var(--neon-red);
    background-color: rgba(255, 45, 63, 0.08);
    color: #ff8a90;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 45, 63, 0.3);
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.modules-jump:hover {
    color: #f08cc4;
    border-color: var(--neon-magenta);
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(224, 33, 138, 0.5);
}
</style>
```

To accompany the HSMA course, we have written several eBooks.

These are freely available to all - please share them with anyone you think would find them useful!

Prefer to follow along with the original session recordings, slides and exercises? Head to the [modules](modules.qmd) page instead.
